name: TeamStarWolf - The Year 2026 in Intrusions (ICS)
description: Curated case-study layer, not an official MITRE mapping. ATT&CK for ICS techniques from the 2026 record: the ids AA26-097A (Iranian-affiliated PLC activity) and AA26-231A (Siemens S7 activity) print, and the behaviors in CERT Polska's account of the Polish energy attack (through CISA), CISA's water-sector alert, Darktrace's ZionSiphon analysis and France's and CERT-FR's account of the retail refrigeration attacks. T1693.001 is the v20 successor of the revoked T0857. Each comment names source numbers from case-studies/CHRONICLE_2026.md. Scores: 100 an opened source prints the id, 70 the source describes the behavior and the study assigns the id, 40 the mapping is Inferred.
